title: 3D Shapes: Cubes, Cuboids, Cylinders, Cones and Spheres
seo_title: 3D Shapes – Primary 4 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Identify three-dimensional shapes; distinguish between 2D and 3D shapes; state the properties of 3D shapes (faces, edges and vertices); identify uses of 3D shapes at home. (summary of the NERDC Primary 4 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 4 maths worksheets on 3D shapes: naming cubes, cuboids, cylinders, cones, spheres and pyramids, 2D or 3D, faces, edges and vertices, and 3D shapes at home. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • 2D shapes are flat; 3D shapes are solid and have length, breadth and height.
  • A face is a flat or curved surface, an edge is where two faces meet and a vertex is a corner.
  • A cube has 6 square faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. A cylinder has 2 flat faces and 1 curved face.

Examples

Example

A cuboid

6 faces, 12 edges, 8 vertices

Answer: Like a box of matches

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Calling a cube a squareA square is flat (2D); a cube is solid (3D).
Counting the same edge twiceMark each edge as you count.
Forgetting curved facesA cylinder has a curved face as well as two flat faces.

items.q: What is the name of this 3-D shape?
items.e: It has 6 faces and they are all squares of the same size, so it is a cube.

items.q: Name this 3-D shape.
items.e: It has 6 faces and they are all squares of the same size, so it is a cube. It is turned, but it is still a cube.

items.q: What is this 3-D shape called?
items.e: It has 6 rectangle faces and they are not all squares, so it is a cuboid.

items.q: What is the name of this 3-D shape?
items.e: It has 6 rectangle faces and they are not all squares, so it is a cuboid. It is standing on its end, but it is still a cuboid.

items.q: Name this 3-D shape.
items.e: It has 2 triangle faces at the ends, joined by 3 rectangles, so it is a triangular prism. A pyramid comes to a point; a prism does not.

items.q: What is this 3-D shape called?
items.e: It has 2 triangle faces at the ends, joined by 3 rectangles, so it is a triangular prism. It is standing on a triangle face, but it is still a triangular prism. A pyramid comes to a point; a prism does not.

items.q: What is the name of this 3-D shape?
items.e: It has 2 triangle faces at the ends, joined by 3 rectangles, so it is a triangular prism. It is turned so you see a triangle end at the front. A pyramid comes to a point; a prism does not.

items.q: Name this 3-D shape.
items.e: It has a square face at the bottom and 4 triangle faces that meet at a point, so it is a square-based pyramid.

items.q: What is this 3-D shape called?
items.e: It has a square face at the bottom and 4 triangle faces that meet at a point, so it is a square-based pyramid. It is turned, but it is still a square-based pyramid.
It has 2 circle faces at the ends and a curved surface, so it is a cylinder.
It has 2 circle faces at the ends and a curved surface, so it is a cylinder. It is lying on its side, but it is still a cylinder.
It has 1 circle face and a curved surface that comes to a point, so it is a cone.
It has 1 circle face and a curved surface that comes to a point, so it is a cone. It is upside down, but it is still a cone.
It has 1 circle face and a curved surface that comes to a point, so it is a cone. It is lying on its side, but it is still a cone.
It is round all over, like a ball, so it is a sphere. A circle is a flat 2-D shape.

items.q: Both pictures show the same 3-D shape in different positions. What is it?
items.e: It has 2 triangle faces at the ends, joined by 3 rectangles, so it is a triangular prism. Turning a shape does not change its name.
It has 2 circle faces at the ends and a curved surface, so it is a cylinder. Turning a shape does not change its name.
A is a cone: it has 1 circle face and comes to a point. It is lying on its side.
B is a cuboid: it has 6 rectangle faces that are not all squares. It is standing on its end.
C is a triangular prism: it has 2 triangle faces joined by rectangles. It is standing on a triangle.

items.q: How many faces does a triangular prism have?
items.e: A triangular prism has 5 faces, 9 edges and 6 vertices: 5.

items.q: How many vertices (corners) does a cone have?
items.e: A cone has 2 faces, 1 edges and 1 vertices: 1.

items.q: How many faces does a tetrahedron (triangular-based pyramid) have?
items.e: A tetrahedron (triangular-based pyramid) has 4 faces, 6 edges and 4 vertices: 4.

items.q: How many edges does a cylinder have?
items.e: A cylinder has 3 faces, 2 edges and 0 vertices: 2.

items.q: A flat surface of a 3-D shape is called a …
items.e: A face is a flat surface. An edge is where two faces meet. A vertex is a corner.

items.q: The line where two faces of a 3-D shape meet is called an …
items.e: Where two faces meet there is an edge.

items.q: A corner of a 3-D shape, where edges meet, is called a …
items.e: A corner is a vertex. More than one vertex are called vertices.

items.q: This is a cube. How many faces does it have?
items.e: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. Some faces are at the back. You cannot see them, but you must count them too.

items.q: How many flat faces does a cube have?
items.e: A cube has 6 flat faces. In the picture you can see only 3. The other 3 are at the back and at the bottom: 3 + 3 = 6.

items.q: How many flat faces does a cuboid have?
items.e: A cuboid has 6 flat faces: top and bottom, front and back, and 2 ends. You can see only 3 of them.
A cylinder has 2 flat faces: a circle at the top and a circle at the bottom. The curved face is not flat, so do not count it.
A cone has 1 flat face: the circle at the bottom. The rest is a curved face.
A sphere is round all over. It has no flat faces, only a curved face.
A cylinder has 1 curved face that goes all the way round. Its 2 circle faces are flat.
A sphere has 1 curved face that goes all the way round. It has no flat faces.

items.q: What shape is each face of a cube?
items.e: All 6 faces of a cube are squares of the same size. The cube is 3D; each face is a flat square.

items.q: What shape are the faces of this cuboid?
items.e: The faces of this cuboid are rectangles. A cuboid is a 3D shape; its faces are flat 2D shapes.
The flat faces of a cylinder are circles. In a picture they look squashed because we see them from the side.
The flat face of a cone is a circle. From the side a cone looks like a triangle, but it has no triangle face.

items.q: Which shape has only flat faces?
items.e: A cube has 6 flat faces and no curved face. A cylinder and a cone have a curved face too. A sphere has only a curved face.

items.q: Which shape has only a curved face?
items.e: A sphere has 1 curved face and no flat faces. A cylinder and a cone also have flat faces.

items.q: Which shape has 1 flat face and 1 curved face?
items.e: A cone has 1 flat circle face and 1 curved face. A cylinder has 2 flat faces.

items.q: Which shape has 2 flat faces and 1 curved face?
items.e: A cylinder has 2 flat circle faces and 1 curved face. A cone has only 1 flat face.

items.q: Zainab draws around the bottom of a tin of milk. What shape does she draw?
items.e: The tin is a cylinder. Its bottom face is a flat circle, so Zainab draws a circle.

items.q: Abdullahi dips one face of a die in paint and presses it on paper. What shape does he print?
items.e: Every face of a die (a cube) is a square, so the print is a square. A print is flat, so it cannot be a cube.

items.q: Funke counts the flat faces of a cube in a picture and gets 3. What did she forget?
items.e: A picture shows only 3 faces of a cube. There are 3 more at the back and at the bottom. 3 + 3 = 6 flat faces.
D is a cylinder. It has a curved face. The cube and the cuboids have only flat faces.
A is a sphere. It has only a curved face. The cylinder has 2 flat faces, the cone has 1 and the cube has 6.
